id.description: The id the kind is found by: a word of lower-case letters, digits and `_`, 1 to 32.

title.description: Its name for people, as the new-tab menu and a tab say it.

help.description: A line saying what it is.

icon.description: The name of one of the application's icons; a name it does not know draws the default.

x-enum-labels.terminal: A shell on the host: the one named by [`TabInfo::shell`], or the host's own choice.
x-enum-labels.log: Lines of text the provider keeps, which [`PanelTab::tail`] answers and the application shows as they come.
x-enum-labels.page: A page the extension serves on this computer's loopback, at [`TabInfo::url`]: the tab names it and opens it in the person's browser, since the application has no web view of its own.

shows.description: What a tab of this kind shows.

shell.description: For [`Shows::Terminal`]: the id of the shell the host lists that a new tab runs; none for the host's own choice.

url.description: For [`Shows::Page`]: the address of the page, `http` or `https` on this computer's loopback (`127.0.0.1`, `[::1]` or `localhost`, with or without a port), which the extension's own server answers.
